messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "10 to 15 mg/kg/day given in 3 divided doses for patients 3 to 11 years of age"
set: ["10 to 15 mg/kg/day given in 3 divided doses for patients 3 to 11 years of age", "40 mg/kg/day for patients 3 to 4 years of age", "25 to 35 mg/kg/day for patients 5 to 11 years of age", "dose is given in 3 divided doses", "children 3 to 17 years of age", "given in divided doses", "children under 3 years of age for ADHD", "patients less than 3 years", "4 mg oral dose administered 3 times a day for patients aged 4 to 11 years", "children under 15 years of age", "oral administration recommended for patients aged 4 to 11 years", "immediate-release (IR), ages 3 to 5 years", "3 years and older", "3 to 7 days", "2 to 3 weeks", "2 to 3 hours"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
